question.value: What are the physical and kinematical structure of the disk and jet of the massive (proto)star IRAS 20126+4104?

evidence.quote: The new data allow us to improve on previous similar observations of IRAS 20126+4104 and confirm the existence of a Keplerian accretion disk around a $\sim$12 $M_\odot$ (proto)star.
The ALMA observations of IRAS 20126+4104 were performed in band 6 at three epochs

claims.hypothesis: Is the disk Keplerian with additional infall?
claims.experiment: PV diagrams and disk velocity model fit to CH3CN peaks
claims.finding: Keplerian rotation plus radial velocity ~40% of rotation

evidence.quote: The disk is undergoing Keplerian rotation but a non-negligible radial velocity component is also present that is equal to $\sim$40% of the rotational component.

claims.experiment: Toomre Q from Trot and Ncol profiles

evidence.quote: Since by definition $R<R_{\rm d}$, one has $Q>1$ at all radii, which implies that the disk is stable.

claims.hypothesis: A dusty envelope explains the C-shaped peak distribution
claims.experiment: Disk+halo toy model with tau0 varied

evidence.quote: We conclude that the model qualitatively mimics the C-shaped distribution of the data peaks, lending support to our interpretation.
